È comparsa all'improvviso dopo un trauma: It appeared suddenly after an injury, an operation, an effort or an infection
È il dolore sul lato o davanti alla spal: This is pain at the side or front of the shoulder when you raise your arm, linked to the rotator cuff tendons and the structures under the acromion (once called “impingement”). It is a real and common problem; the idea that it is caused by poor posture or by “pinching” is now downplayed.
È il lavoro alzato: carico per ripetizio: It's the total work lifted: load × reps, added up across the logged sets.
È il mal di schiena che dura da più di 1: This is back pain that lasts more than 12 weeks with no specific identifiable cause (fracture, tumour, infection, severe radiculopathy). It is a real problem and the leading cause of disability worldwide, but it is rarely linked to “bad posture”.
È il messaggio che mandi a ogni nuovo cl: This is the message you send to every new client. Wherever you write these words in curly braces, the app fills in their details:
È il riferimento di forza specifica di u: It's the strength benchmark for a specific exercise.
È il riferimento rispetto a cui leggere: It's the baseline your recent load is read against.
È la fascia di volume nella quale i dati: It's the volume range in which the available data suggest a good balance between stimulus and fatigue cost. It's an individual estimate and can change over time.
È la risposta alla domanda “sto diventan: It answers the question “am I performing better?”, not “how much work have I done?”.
It's context, not a medical traffic light.
È un dolore sul lato dell'anca (il troca: This is pain at the side of the hip (the trochanter), worse when lying on that side, climbing stairs or standing on one leg. It is a problem of the gluteal tendons, often called “bursitis” or blamed on a postural problem.
È un riferimento, non un ordine automati: It's a reference, not an automatic order to reduce sets.
È una percezione. Due persone possono da: It's subjective. Two people can rate the same set differently.
È una stima del massimale a una ripetizi: It's an estimate of your one-rep max, not a tested 1RM. It starts from the load and reps of the set and is mainly used to compare the same exercise over time.
È una stima del volume dal quale iniziam: It's an estimate of the volume from which we start to see a positive response. It's not a universal number valid for everyone.
È una stima percepita, non un conteggio: It's a perceived estimate, not a physiological count.
È un’ottica in più, non la metrica princ: It's one more lens, not the main metric.
